lines.plainText: Personates thee and thy lopp'd branches point

lines.text: Thy two sons forth, who, by Belarius stol'n,
lines.plainText: Thy two sons forth who by Belarius stol'n

lines.text: For many years thought dead, are now reviv'd,
lines.plainText: For many years thought dead are now reviv'd

lines.text: To the majestic cedar join'd, whose issue
lines.plainText: To the majestic cedar join'd whose issue

lines.text: Promises Britain peace and plenty.
lines.plainText: Promises Britain peace and plenty

lines.text: Well,
lines.plainText: Well

lines.text: My peace we will begin. And, Caius Lucius,
lines.plainText: My peace we will begin And Caius Lucius

lines.text: Although the victor, we submit to Cæsar
lines.plainText: Although the victor we submit to Csar

lines.text: And to the Roman empire, promising
lines.plainText: And to the Roman empire promising

lines.text: To pay our wonted tribute, from the which
lines.plainText: To pay our wonted tribute from the which

lines.text: We were dissuaded by our wicked queen,
lines.plainText: We were dissuaded by our wicked queen

lines.text: Whom heavens in justice, both on her and hers,
lines.plainText: Whom heavens in justice both on her and hers

lines.text: Have laid most heavy hand.
lines.plainText: Have laid most heavy hand

lines.text: The fingers of the pow'rs above do tune
lines.plainText: The fingers of the pow'rs above do tune

lines.text: The harmony of this peace. The vision
lines.plainText: The harmony of this peace The vision

lines.text: Which I made known to Lucius ere the stroke
lines.plainText: Which I made known to Lucius ere the stroke

lines.text: Of yet this scarce-cold battle, at this instant
lines.plainText: Of yet this scarcecold battle at this instant

lines.text: Is full accomplish'd; for the Roman eagle,
lines.plainText: Is full accomplish'd for the Roman eagle

lines.text: From south to west on wing soaring aloft,
lines.plainText: From south to west on wing soaring aloft

lines.text: Lessen'd herself and in the beams o' th' sun
lines.plainText: Lessen'd herself and in the beams o' th' sun

lines.text: So vanish'd; which foreshow'd our princely eagle,
lines.plainText: So vanish'd which foreshow'd our princely eagle

lines.text: Th' imperial Cæsar, should again unite
lines.plainText: Th' imperial Csar should again unite

lines.text: His favour with the radiant Cymbeline,
lines.plainText: His favour with the radiant Cymbeline

lines.text: Which shines here in the west.
lines.plainText: Which shines here in the west

lines.text: Laud we the gods;
lines.plainText: Laud we the gods

lines.text: And let our crooked smokes climb to their nostrils
lines.plainText: And let our crooked smokes climb to their nostrils

lines.text: From our bless'd altars. Publish we this peace
lines.plainText: From our bless'd altars Publish we this peace

lines.text: To all our subjects. Set we forward; let
lines.plainText: To all our subjects Set we forward let

lines.text: A Roman and a British ensign wave
lines.plainText: A Roman and a British ensign wave

lines.text: Friendly together. So through Lud's Town march;
lines.plainText: Friendly together So through Lud's Town march

lines.text: And in the temple of great Jupiter
lines.plainText: And in the temple of great Jupiter

lines.text: Our peace we'll ratify; seal it with feasts.
lines.plainText: Our peace we'll ratify seal it with feasts

lines.text: Set on there! Never was a war did cease,
lines.plainText: Set on there Never was a war did cease

lines.text: Ere bloody hands were wash'd, with such a peace.
lines.plainText: Ere bloody hands were wash'd with such a peace
